#Set Working Directory & Load Packages
```{r}
#set working directory
setwd("~/Desktop/blameassignment")

#load packages
library(psych)
library(effects)
library(corrplot)
library(corrgram)
library(stats)
library(plotrix)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

```

#Load in Anonymized Data (this is the file available on OSF)
```{r}
#load in data frame
qualtrics <- read.csv("Blame Assignment Study 3 Anon.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#turn all blanks to NA
qualtrics <- qualtrics %>% mutate_all(na_if,"")

#no headers
df <- qualtrics %>%
  filter(DistributionChannel == "anonymous") #1248 entries

#frequency of each ID
df.duplicateIDs <- df %>% 
  group_by(anon_id) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(freq=n())

#df that has only unique IDs
df.unique <- df.duplicateIDs %>%
  filter(freq == 1)

#only retain rows in original data file that are in the "unique" df
df.2 <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(anon_id %in% c(df.unique$anon_id))

#filter out anyone who is not American
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(citizenship == 1)

#filter out anyone who did not identity as white or black
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(race == 1 | race == 2)

#filter out those who did not consent
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  rename(consent = Q11)

df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(consent==1)

```

#Make Condition Variable
```{r}
#condition
df.2$condition <- rep(NA,nrow(df.2))

df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$packedboth_1)] <- 1 #Packed Both
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedwhite_1)] <- 2 #Unpacked White
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedblack_1)] <- 3 #Unpacked Black
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedboth_1)] <- 4 #Unpacked Both

table(df.2$condition, useNA="ifany")

df.2 <- df.2 %>% filter(condition<5)

```

#Data Cleaning
```{r}
#delete Qualtrics columns
df.2$Status <- NULL
df.2$Progress <- NULL
df.2$Duration..in.seconds. <- NULL
df.2$Finished <- NULL
df.2$RecipientLastName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientFirstName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientEmail <- NULL
df.2$ExternalReference <- NULL
df.2$DistributionChannel <- NULL
df.2$UserLanguage <- NULL

```

#Finalize Clean Data
```{r}
#create new data frame
df.3 <- df.2

#check consent
table(df.3$consent)

#check conditions
table(df.3$condition)

#turn all variables to numeric
df.4 <- data.frame(lapply(df.3, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

```

#Data Demographics
```{r}
#gender
tablegender <- table(df.4$gender)
prop.table(tablegender)*100

#age
df.4 %>% summarize(mean_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

#race
tablerace <- table(df.4$race)
prop.table(tablerace)*100

```

#Create Blame Variables
```{r}
#Condition 1: Packed Both
#Condition 2: Unpacked White
#Condition 3: Unpacked Black
#Condition 4: Unpacked Both

#packed both
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c1_blameblack = packedboth_2)

#unpacked white
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c2_blameblack = unpackedwhite_1)

#unpacked black
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c3_blameblack = unpackedblack_2 +
           unpackedblack_3 +
           unpackedblack_4 +
           unpackedblack_5 +
           unpackedblack_6)

#unpacked both
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c4_blameblack = unpackedboth_6 +
           unpackedboth_7 +
           unpackedboth_8 +
           unpackedboth_9 +
           unpackedboth_10)

#blame black variable
df.4$blameblack <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blameblack <- pmax(df.4$c1_blameblack, df.4$c2_blameblack, df.4$c3_blameblack, df.4$c4_blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)

summary(df.4$blameblack)

#blame white variable
df.4$blamewhite <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blamewhite <- 100-df.4$blameblack

summary(df.4$blamewhite)

```

#Analyses
```{r}
#Condition 1: Packed Both
#Condition 2: Unpacked White
#Condition 3: Unpacked Black
#Condition 4: Unpacked Both

#turn numeric variables into factors
df.4$condition <- as.factor(df.4$condition)
df.4$race <- as.factor(df.4$race)
df.4$politicalorientation <- as.factor(df.4$politicalorientation)

#make binary variable for unpacked white
df.4$binaryunpackedwhite <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$binaryunpackedwhite <- ifelse(df.4$condition==2 | df.4$condition==4, 1, 0)

df.4$binaryunpackedwhite <- as.factor(df.4$binaryunpackedwhite)

#make binary variable for unpacked black
df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- ifelse(df.4$condition==3 | df.4$condition==4, 1, 0)

df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- as.factor(df.4$binaryunpackedblack)

#set ANOVA defaults to SPSS defaults
options(contrasts = c("contr.helmert", "contr.poly"))
options("contrasts")

library(car)
library(sjstats)

#3 way ANOVA
anova1 <- lm(blameblack ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova1,type=3)

anova1effect <-Anova(anova1,type=3)
eta_sq(anova1effect, partial = T)

#2 way ANOVA
anova2 <- lm(blameblack ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack, data = df.4)

Anova(anova2,type=3)

anova2effect <-Anova(anova2,type=3)
eta_sq(anova2effect, partial = T)

#correlation
df.4$race <- as.numeric(df.4$race)

cor.test(df.4$race, df.4$blameblack)

df.4$race <- as.factor(df.4$race)

#summary statistics by condition
conditionsummarytable <- df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(condition) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blameblack=sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blameblack=sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

```

#online supplementary materials - blame assigned to each subgroup
```{r}
#Condition 1: Packed Both
#Condition 2: Unpacked White
#Condition 3: Unpacked Black
#Condition 4: Unpacked Both

#Condition 1: Packed Both
df.condition1 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==1) %>% select(packedboth_1, packedboth_2)

df.condition1 <- df.condition1 %>% 
  rename(white = packedboth_1) %>% 
  rename(black = packedboth_2)

df.condition1 <- df.condition1 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition1.long <- df.condition1 %>% pivot_longer(
  !participantid,
  names_to = "group",
  names_prefix = "packedboth_",
  values_to = "blame",
  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition1table <- df.condition1.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)


#Condition 2: Unpacked White

df.condition2 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==2) %>% select(unpackedwhite_1, unpackedwhite_2, unpackedwhite_3, unpackedwhite_4, unpackedwhite_5, unpackedwhite_6)

df.condition2 <- df.condition2 %>% 
  rename(unpackedwhite_black = unpackedwhite_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwhite_strongrepublicanwhite = unpackedwhite_2) %>%
  rename(unpackedwhite_moderaterepublicanwhite = unpackedwhite_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwhite_strongdemocratwhite = unpackedwhite_4) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwhite_moderatedemocratwhite = unpackedwhite_5) %>% 
  rename(unpackedwhite_independentwhite = unpackedwhite_6)

df.condition2 <- df.condition2 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition2.long <- df.condition2 %>% pivot_longer(
  !participantid,
  names_to = "group",
  names_prefix = "unpackedwhite_",
  values_to = "blame",
  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition2table <- df.condition2.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)


#Condition 3: Unpacked Black

df.condition3 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==3) %>% select(unpackedblack_1, unpackedblack_2, unpackedblack_3, unpackedblack_4, unpackedblack_5, unpackedblack_6)

df.condition3 <- df.condition3 %>% 
  rename(unpackedblack_white = unpackedblack_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedblack_strongrepublicanblack = unpackedblack_2) %>%
  rename(unpackedblack_moderaterepublicanblack = unpackedblack_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedblack_strongdemocratblack = unpackedblack_4) %>% 
  rename(unpackedblack_moderatedemocratblack = unpackedblack_5) %>% 
  rename(unpackedblack_independentblack = unpackedblack_6)

df.condition3 <- df.condition3 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition3.long <- df.condition3 %>% pivot_longer(
  !participantid,
  names_to = "group",
  names_prefix = "unpackedblack_",
  values_to = "blame",
  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition3table <- df.condition3.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)


#Condition 4: Unpacked Both

df.condition4 <- df.4 %>% filter(condition==4) %>% select(unpackedboth_1, unpackedboth_2, unpackedboth_3, unpackedboth_4, unpackedboth_5, unpackedboth_6, unpackedboth_7, unpackedboth_8, unpackedboth_9, unpackedboth_10)

df.condition4 <- df.condition4 %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_strongrepublicanwhite = unpackedboth_1) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_moderaterepublicanwhite = unpackedboth_2) %>%
  rename(unpackedboth_strongdemocratwhite = unpackedboth_3) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_moderatedemocratwhite = unpackedboth_4) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_independentwhite = unpackedboth_5) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_strongrepublicanblack = unpackedboth_6) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_moderaterepublicanblack = unpackedboth_7) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_strongdemocratblack = unpackedboth_8) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_moderatedemocratblack = unpackedboth_9) %>% 
  rename(unpackedboth_independentblack = unpackedboth_10)

df.condition4 <- df.condition4 %>% mutate(participantid = row_number())

df.condition4.long <- df.condition4 %>% pivot_longer(

  values_drop_na = FALSE)

condition4table <- df.condition4.long %>% group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blame=sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blame=mean(blame, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blame, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,

```

#online supplementary analyses - entitativity, group identification, and differentiation
```{r}
#make entitativity variables
df.entitativitywhite <- df.4 %>%
  select(entiativity_1:entiativity_4)

df.4$entitativitywhite <- rowMeans(df.entitativitywhite, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1)

df.entitativityblack <- df.4 %>%
  select(entiativity_5:entiativity_8)

df.4$entitativityblack <- rowMeans(df.entitativityblack, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1)

#make identification variables
df.identificationwhite <- df.4 %>% 
  select(identification_1, identification_7)

df.4$identificationwhite <- rowMeans(df.identificationwhite, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1) #white

df.identificationblack <- df.4 %>% 
  select(identification_4, identification_10)

df.4$identificationblack <- rowMeans(df.identificationblack, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1) #black

df.identificationwhitedemocrat <- df.4 %>% 
  select(identification_2, identification_8)

df.4$identificationwhitedemocrat <- rowMeans(df.identificationwhitedemocrat, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1) #white democrat

df.identificationblackdemocrat <- df.4 %>% 
  select(identification_5, identification_11)

df.4$identificationblackdemocrat <- rowMeans(df.identificationblackdemocrat, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1) #black democrat

df.identificationwhiterepublican <- df.4 %>% 
  select(identification_3, identification_9)

df.4$identificationwhiterepublican <- rowMeans(df.identificationwhiterepublican, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1) #white republican

df.identificationblackrepublican <- df.4 %>% 
  select(identification_6, identification_12)

df.4$identificationblackrepublican <- rowMeans(df.identificationblackrepublican, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1) #black republican

#make differentiation variables
df.differentiationwhite <- df.4 %>%
  select(differentiation_1:differentiation_4)

df.4$differentiationwhite <- rowMeans(df.differentiationwhite, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1)

df.differentiationblack <- df.4 %>%
  select(differentiation_5:differentiation_8)

df.4$differentiationblack <- rowMeans(df.differentiationblack, na.rm=TRUE, dims=1)

#check variable types
df.4$binaryunpackedwhite <- as.factor(df.4$binarypackedwhite)
df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- as.factor(df.4$binaryunpackedblack)
df.4$race <- as.factor(df.4$race)

df.4$entitativitywhite <- as.numeric(df.4$entitativitywhite)
df.4$entitativityblack <- as.numeric(df.4$entitativityblack)
df.4$identificationwhite <- as.numeric(df.4$identificationwhite)
df.4$identificationblack <- as.numeric(df.4$identificationblack)
df.4$identificationwhitedemocrat <- as.numeric(df.4$identificationwhitedemocrat)
df.4$identificationblackdemocrat <- as.numeric(df.4$identificationblackdemocrat)
df.4$identificationwhiterepublican <- as.numeric(df.4$identificationwhiterepublican)
df.4$identificationblackrepublican <- as.numeric(df.4$identificationblackrepublican)
df.4$differentiationwhite <- as.numeric(df.4$differentiationwhite)
df.4$differentiationblack <- as.numeric(df.4$differentiationblack)

#check reliability
psych::alpha(df.entitativitywhite)
psych::alpha(df.entitativityblack)

psych::alpha(df.identificationwhite)
psych::alpha(df.identificationblack)
psych::alpha(df.identificationwhitedemocrat)
psych::alpha(df.identificationblackdemocrat)
psych::alpha(df.identificationwhiterepublican)
psych::alpha(df.identificationblackrepublican)

psych::alpha(df.differentiationwhite)
psych::alpha(df.differentiationblack)

#analyses - entitativity
anova3 <- lm(entitativitywhite ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova3,type=3)

anova4 <- lm(entitativityblack ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova4,type=3)

#analyses - identification
anova5 <- lm(identificationwhite ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova5,type=3)

anova6 <- lm(identificationblack ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova6,type=3)

anova7 <- lm(identificationwhitedemocrat ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova7,type=3)

anova8 <- lm(identificationblackdemocrat ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova8,type=3)

anova9 <- lm(identificationwhiterepublican ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova9,type=3)

anova10 <- lm(identificationblackrepublican ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova10,type=3)

#analyses - differentiation
anova11 <- lm(differentiationwhite ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova11,type=3)

anova12 <- lm(differentiationblack ~ binaryunpackedwhite * binaryunpackedblack * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova12,type=3)

#correlation table with social identity measures
library(apaTables)

df.correlation <- df.4 %>%
  select(entitativitywhite, entitativityblack, identificationwhite, identificationblack, identificationwhitedemocrat, identificationblackdemocrat, identificationwhiterepublican, identificationblackrepublican, differentiationwhite, differentiationblack)

apa.cor.table(df.correlation, filename="TableStudy3SocialIdentity_APA.doc", table.number=1)

```
